title: Backend Engineer
description:
Zeta is hiring a Backend Engineer for the core banking ledger team in Bengaluru.

What you will do:
- Design and operate services that move money, written in Node.js and TypeScript.
- Own PostgreSQL schema design, including migrations on tables that cannot take downtime.
- Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by partner banks.
- Participate in a weekly on-call rotation for the ledger platform.

Requirements:
- 3-6 years building backend services in production.
- Strong PostgreSQL: you have debugged a slow query plan and fixed it.
- Experience with AWS and containerised deploys (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes).
- Comfortable writing tests for systems where correctness is not optional.

Nice to have: Kafka or another message queue, Terraform, prior fintech experience.
